faq.title: Funding FAQs
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common funding questions
faq.a1: No. It's a purchase of future receivables (MCA). Payments are based on your sales.
faq.q2: How fast can I get funded?
faq.a2: If approved, funding as soon as 1–2 business days (subject to approval). Speed matters when opportunities arise.
faq.a3: No hard pull to prequalify. We look at overall business performance and revenue patterns.
faq.q4: How much funding could I receive?
faq.a4: Amounts vary based on revenue and time in business. A specialist will tailor options to your situation.
faq.a5: Typically a valid ID and recent business bank statements. Additional docs may be requested by providers.
faq.a6: Repayment is a percentage of your receivables, adjusting with your sales—no fixed monthly payment like a loan.
faq.a7: We serve a wide range including restaurants, retail, trucking, salons, and contractors.
faq.a8: No obligation to accept an offer. By applying, you consent to be contacted about funding options.
faq.q9: How long does the approval process take?
faq.a9: Check eligibility quickly, with no obligation. Full approval typically happens within 1-2 business days for qualified businesses (subject to approval). We prioritize speed without sacrificing thoroughness.
faq.q10: Can I get funding during economic uncertainty?
faq.a10: Yes. Many businesses actually expand during economic downturns when competition reduces.
faq.q11: How do rising interest rates affect my funding costs?
faq.a11: Our revenue-based funding isn't tied to traditional interest rates like bank loans. Costs are fixed based on your business performance.
faq.q12: What if my industry is seasonal?
faq.a12: Perfect fit! Our payments adjust with your sales, so you pay less during slow seasons and more when business picks up.
faq.q13: Should I wait for better market conditions?
faq.a13: Waiting often costs more than the funding itself. Markets are unpredictable, but growth opportunities are time-sensitive.
faq.q14: How does funding help during an economic slowdown?
faq.a14: Well-funded businesses can expand when competitors pull back, gaining market share and acquiring assets at better prices.
faq.q15: What's the difference between working capital and other funding?
faq.a15: Working capital covers day-to-day operations, inventory, and cash flow gaps. It's essential for business stability and growth.

howUse.item1: Evaluate your funding eligibility and provide funding services
howUse.item2: Communicate with you about our services
howUse.item4: Comply with legal obligations and protect our rights

sharing.title: Information Sharing
sharing.desc: We may share your information with trusted partners and service providers who help us deliver our services, including lenders and funding partners. We require these parties to protect your information and use it only for the purposes we specify.

security.title: Data Security
security.desc: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. We use industry-standard encryption and security protocols.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.desc: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. You may also opt out of certain communications from us. To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information below.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.desc: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve your experience on our website, analyze usage patterns, and provide personalized content. You can control cookie settings through your browser.

updates.title: Updates to This Policy
updates.desc: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on our website and updating the "Last updated" date.

contactUs.title: Contact Us
contactUs.intro: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our data practices, please contact us at:

terms.metaDescription: WispFi terms of use and service agreement.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.desc: By accessing and using this website and our services, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. These terms apply to all visitors, users, and others who access or use our service.

serviceDesc.title: Service Description
serviceDesc.desc: WispFi provides business funding services including merchant cash advances and other financing solutions. We connect businesses with funding partners to help meet their capital needs. All funding is subject to approval and qualification requirements.

eligibility.title: Eligibility Requirements
eligibility.intro: To be eligible for our services, you must:
eligibility.item1: Be at least 18 years of age
eligibility.item2: Have the authority to bind your business to agreements
eligibility.item3: Operate a legitimate business in the United States
eligibility.item4: Meet minimum revenue and time-in-business requirements

application.title: Application Process
application.desc: When you submit an application, you authorize us to verify the information provided and share it with our funding partners. You agree to provide accurate, complete, and current information. False or misleading information may result in application denial.

noGuarantee.title: No Guarantee of Approval
noGuarantee.desc: Submitting an application does not guarantee approval for funding. All applications are subject to review and approval by our funding partners based on their individual criteria. We do not guarantee any specific funding amount or terms.

fees.title: Fees and Charges
fees.desc: There are no upfront fees for submitting an application or receiving funding offers. Any fees associated with funding will be clearly disclosed in your funding agreement if approved. You are responsible for understanding all terms before accepting any funding offer.

privacyData.title: Privacy and Data Use
privacyData.desc: Your privacy is important to us. Please review our Privacy Policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your information. By using our services, you consent to our data practices as described in our Privacy Policy.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.desc: WispFi shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of our services. Our liability shall not exceed the amount of fees paid to us for our services.

governing.title: Governing Law
governing.desc: These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Florida, without regard to its conflict of law provisions. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Orange County, Florida.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.desc: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting on our website. Your continued use of our services after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.

contactInfo.intro: If you have any questions about these Terms of Use, please contact us at:

thankYou2.uploadTitle: Want to Get Funded Even Faster?
thankYou2.uploadSubtitle: To speed things up, you can upload your documents now so we can start processing before our call. If you prefer, you can wait until we speak with you.
thankYou2.bankStatementsDesc: Most recent 3 months of business bank statements
thankYou2.driversLicenseDesc: Front & back of your driver's license
thankYou2.docUploadedDesc: We've received your document and will review it shortly.
thankYou2.faq1Q: Will you do a hard credit pull?
thankYou2.faq1A: No hard credit pull is required for prequalification. We focus on your business performance and revenue patterns instead.
thankYou2.faq2A: Typically just business bank statements and ID. Our specialist will guide you through any additional requirements during your call.
thankYou2.faq3A: Payments are a percentage of your daily receivables, so they adjust with your sales. No fixed monthly payments like a traditional loan.
thankYou2.faq4A: Absolutely not. There's no obligation to accept any offer. We'll present options and you decide what's best for your business.
thankYou2.contactTitle: Need to Reach Us Before Your Call?
thankYou2.urgentFundingDesc: Call us immediately at (818) 858-0184. We can often provide quick decisions (subject to approval) for qualifying businesses.
thankYou2.within24HoursDesc: Personal call to discuss your funding options
thankYou2.within48HoursDesc: Funding deposited to your business account

thankYouCommon.missCallQ: What if I miss the call?

thankYouCommon.notApprovedA: We work with multiple lenders and have various programs. If one doesn't fit, we'll explore alternatives that might work for you.
